name: Placement of illicit funds via the entity
description: Bad actor introduces proceeds of crime into the regulated financial system through the entity (cash, structured deposits, third-party payments).

name: Layering through internal / external transfers
description: Multiple movements of funds across accounts, products or counterparties to obscure origin. Detected only post-event without behavioural rules.

name: Integration through legitimate-seeming transactions
description: Layered funds re-emerge as apparently legitimate income (loans, real estate, business invoices, dividends).

name: Terrorism financing flow
description: Small, structured outflows to a person or organisation linked to terrorism. Often below TM thresholds, requires intelligence-led detection.

name: Suspicion identified, no STR / SAR filed
description: Internal escalation captures a suspicion, but no report goes to the FIU; tipping-off rules also breached.

name: EDD failure on PEP / high-risk customer
description: PEP, high-risk-jurisdiction or complex-ownership customer onboarded or maintained without EDD; SoF/SoW evidence missing.
